scope: One bounded offline source extract. The query selects features with at least one node in the bbox; complete returned way geometry may extend beyond it. No live runtime API usage.
heightSemantics: OSM height is physical height above the lowest ground point including roof, not MSL elevation. Untagged units are metres. building:levels counts above-ground facade storeys excluding roof/basement. Converting levels/defaults to metres is an estimate.
notes: No response remark/error returned. Response contains complete geometry for returned ways and relation members.
Raw source retains OSM tags and IDs for provenance; the runtime converter should keep only fields necessary for scenery.
Keep raw and derived OSM datasets under ODbL-1.0 and provide corresponding downloadable data/rebuild material when publicly distributing or using derived data.
The building/road query is a one-time small development extraction; runtime must use bundled offline results.
